description: Rank every crypto narrative's index (AI Agents, Layer 1, DeFi, Memes, RWA, ...) against BTC buy-and-hold over a window (7D, 30D, 90D, 180D, YTD, 1Y, 3Y, 5Y; default 90D): each narrative's return, growth over BTC ((1 + return) / (1 + BTC return) − 1), the prior window's, max drawdown, its constituents and weights, and the coins its trim set aside. Each index holds the narrative's 15 largest coins over $10M, none above 10%, rebalanced monthly, with each month's most extreme movers set aside so no single coin carries it. Daily closes.

timeframe.description: The window, ending at the latest close: 7D to 180D count days; 1Y, 3Y and 5Y start on the same calendar date years earlier; YTD starts at the previous year's last close.

name: get_narrative_bench
title: Narrative Bench
